evals.prompt: Most people seem to find our numbers through Discord screenshots and X posts. Where do members actually meet the company, and should we own that?
evals.expected_output: Maps every door, judges each keep, bring home or stop, and routes changes.
expectations: Lists every door with who controls it, weekly count or marked proposal, and what members see there
Gives each door keep, bring home or stop with an owner
Checks where members get help and the first-answer time
Drafts outside-platform changes for the owner and sends or posts nothing

evals.prompt: A tipster site is reposting our NBA projections without the timestamps. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Judges the door and brings it home.
expectations: Records that the door shows stripped numbers without source time
Gives the verdict bring home or stop with the reason
Points members back to the main product as the full product
Leaves any message to the site as a draft for the owner
